tasks.analysis: Ocean currents are critical components of Earth’s climate system, influencing weather patterns and marine ecosystems. Driven by wind, temperature changes, and differences in salinity, ocean currents distribute heat across the globe. The Gulf Stream, for instance, warms the North Atlantic Current, affecting climate in Europe. Deep ocean currents, known as thermohaline circulation, play a role in regulating global temperatures and carbon dioxide levels. Research in oceanography continues to reveal the complexities of these dynamic systems. 洋流是地球气候系统的重要组成部分，影响气候模式与海洋生态系统。洋流由风力、温度变化和盐度差异驱动，在全球范围内分配热量。例如，墨西哥湾暖流加热北大西洋暖流，影响欧洲气候。被称为温盐环流的深海洋流，对调节全球气温与二氧化碳浓度起重要作用。海洋学研究不断揭示这些动态系统的复杂性。
